files.title: File:United States Post Office, Ohio Avenue and North Street, Sidney, OH.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1915, this Classical Revival-style post office was designed by James A. Wetmore to serve the city of Sidney, Ohio.  The building features a red flemish bond brick exterior, limestone base, limestone trim, twelve-over-twelve double-hung windows and casement windows, a cornice with dentils, arched windows on the exterior of the building’s rear wing, a front stoop with brass globe lamp fixtures, fluted stone doric pilasters on the front facade, arched windows flanking the main entrance wit
